notes_zh:
- **新增** 快捷面板支持 ⌘T 一键置顶；置顶后可连续按 ⌘1–9 快速粘贴多项、面板不再关闭，且粘贴目标会自动跟随当前所在的应用，方便在多个 App 间穿插粘贴（#59，感谢 @vvair 的反馈）
- **新增** 设置中可开启「记住上次的分组/分类」，重新打开快捷面板时恢复上次的筛选（默认关闭）
- **优化** 快捷面板窗口拖窄、收起预览区时，列表自动切换为更紧凑的单行布局，一屏看到更多记录
- **优化** 快捷面板右键菜单「复制」移到第一项，与主窗口一致
- **修复** 在 Windows 远程桌面、UU 远程等远程桌面中粘贴只粘出一个 “v” 的问题（#60，感谢 @vvair 的反馈）
- **修复** 快捷面板用 ⌘C 复制图片（及文件等非文本内容）后，粘贴到微信等应用时变成文件路径而非图片
notes_en:
- **New** Press ⌘T to pin the Quick Panel; while pinned, paste multiple items in a row with ⌘1–9 without the panel closing, and the paste target now follows whichever app you're currently in — handy for pasting across several apps (#59, thanks @vvair for the report)
- **New** Optional “Remember last filter” in Settings restores the Quick Panel's last group/category when reopened (off by default)
- **Improve** When the Quick Panel is narrowed or the preview pane is collapsed, the list switches to a tighter single-line layout so you can see more items at a glance
- **Improve** Moved “Copy” to the top of the Quick Panel's right-click menu, matching the main window
- **Fix** Pasting into remote desktops (Windows Remote Desktop, UU Remote, etc.) only produced a “v” — now fixed (#60, thanks @vvair for the report)
- **Fix** Copying an image (or other non-text content like files) from the Quick Panel with ⌘C produced a file path instead of the image when pasting into apps such as WeChat
